text: dsh-session-explorer 是面向 DSH Web 的会话浏览插件，在侧栏提供入口，并在对话区域打开搜索和会话浏览面板。它把会话事件整理到本地 SQLite 全文索引，可按消息正文、工具名称、参数和错误摘要检索，也可浏览会话概览、查看命中消息附近的只读上下文，并跳回原会话定位消息。索引会在启动和会话活动时同步，也支持增量或完整重建。适合需要从大量历史会话中找回内容并继续查看原对话的 DSH Web 用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务；索引保存在本机的 ~/.dsh/storages/session-explorer.sqlite。

dsh-session-explorer adds a DSH Web sidebar for searching and browsing sessions. Its local SQLite index searches messages, tools, and error summaries; users can preview context and jump to a matching turn. The index syncs during use and supports rebuilds. No API key or external service is needed.
想按关键词找出以前某段 DSH 对话里的具体消息。
能不能全文搜索历史会话，还能看到命中内容前后的上下文？
让 DSH Web 可以按工具调用名称或参数查找旧记录。
我想浏览所有会话的概览，再展开某个会话看消息时间线。
从搜索结果直接回到原会话，并尽量跳到对应轮次。
怎么检索以前的用户消息、助手回复和插件注入内容？
Search past DSH conversations for a phrase and inspect the surrounding messages.
Browse session history and jump back to the matching turn in the original conversation.
dsh-session-explorer 的功能「消息全文搜索」：按查询词查找历史消息，并支持消息类型、时间范围和工作目录筛选，结果附带命中片段。
dsh-session-explorer 的功能「会话总览与时间线」：浏览已索引会话及其摘要，并按会话展开轮次和消息条目。
dsh-session-explorer 的功能「只读上下文预览」：从搜索命中打开目标消息附近的上下文页面，便于确认语境。
dsh-session-explorer 的功能「跳回原会话」：从命中结果打开对应会话，并尝试滚动到消息所属轮次；未能定位时退化为切换会话。
dsh-session-explorer 的功能「同步与索引重建」：启动和会话活动会更新本地索引，用户也可发起增量或完整重建。
dsh-session-explorer 会把会话消息整理后存入本机 SQLite 索引文件，工具正文目前不进入全文索引，只索引工具名、参数及错误摘要；查看具体命中可打开只读上下文。

dsh-session-explorer README · dsh-session-explorer：> **English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

DSH Web plugin: message-level full-text search across sessions. Search a specific message (user / assistant / tool / system-injected), preview context read-only, and jump to the real session with one click.

dsh-session-explorer README · Features：- **Message-level full-text search** — user / assistant / system-injected text at high weight, tool name / arguments / error summary at low weight. FTS5 trigram index supports arbitrary substrings without Chinese tokenization; queries shorter than 3 characters fall back to LIKE matching.
- **Four message kinds** — user / assistant / steering (plugin-injected prompts, skill-catalog, skill-invocation, compaction summaries, …) / tool (tool name, arguments and error summary searchable).
- **Deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions** — fork/continuation sessions share parent history, so the same message is stored once per session; search groups by (seq, kind, text) and keeps the session with a non-empty title and the latest index time.
- **Read-only preview** — focused hit plus a surrounding context window; the focus message auto-scrolls to the center of the viewport, and one click opens it in the real session.
- **Session browser entry** — sidebar tool entry + an overlay panel inside the conversation column (no global overlay); the top-left "back to session" button closes the panel.

dsh-session-explorer README · From npm (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-explorer
```

Package page: [https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-explorer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-explorer)

dsh-session-explorer README · Build from source：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-session-explorer-*.tgz
```

After installation, restart `dsh web`; the "Session Explorer" entry appears in the sidebar tool area. The index lives at `~/.dsh/storages/session-explorer.sqlite` (auto-created and indexed on first use).

dsh-session-explorer README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test      # 41 unit tests (requires Node ≥ 22.5, uses node:sqlite)
pnpm build     # tsc + rolldown client bundle
```

dsh-session-explorer README · Architecture：- `src/protocol.ts` — RPC contract types (shared Host/Client)
- `src/transcript.ts` — SessionEvent log → indexable message entries, pure fold layer (zero deps, unit-testable)
- `src/indexer.ts` — SQLite FTS5 trigram derived index (host side, application_id + user_version dual check, 0600 perms)
- `src/rpc.ts` — RPC validation and routing
- `src/index.ts` — host assembly (event sync + RPC + startup reconciliation)
- `src/client/` — browser bundle (sidebar entry + search/preview views + conversation-column overlay panel)

dsh-session-explorer README · Known limitations：- Full tool-result body full-text search is deferred to V2 (only tool name / args / error summary enter the low-weight field today).
- Session deletion has no engine API; index cleanup only covers the plugin's own database.
- The timeline canvas (@xyflow/react) has a serious rendering bug; the entry is hidden since 0.2.0 and will return once fixed.
